name: Kaion
body:
KAION
CR 2

XP 600
N Small magical beast
Init +5; Senses blindsense 60 ft., darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +9

DEFENSE

AC 15, touch 12, flat-footed 14 (+1 size, +1 Dex, +3 natural)
hp 22 (3d10+6)
Fort +5, Ref +4, Will +1

Defensive Abilities void adaptation

OFFENSE

Speed 10 ft., fly 60 ft. (perfect)
Melee 2 slams +4 (1d4+1 B)
Ranged sclerite +4 (1d6+1 P plus entangled, max. range 120 ft.)
Space 5 ft.; Reach 10 ft.
Special Attacks polarity pulse (+4)

STATISTICS

Str 12 (+1); Dex 13 (+1); Con 14 (+2); Int 2 (–4); Wis 10 (+0); Cha 6 (–2)
Base Atk +3; CMB +3; CMD 14 (can’t be tripped)
Feats Improved Initiative, Skill Focus (Perception)
Skills Fly +9, Perception +9
SQ magnetic levitation

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Magnetic Levitation (Ex)

A kaion can fly in a vacuum. However, this flight is limited to within 60 feet of a planet or asteroid’s surface or a nearby metallic structure, such as a steel railing or a starship’s hull.

Polarity Pulse (Ex)

As a standard action, a kaion can release a magnetic pulse in a 60-foot-radius spread. The kaion makes a special combat maneuver, using its Constitution modifier instead of its Strength modifier to determine its CMB. The result is compared to the CMD of each creature in that area wielding metallic weapons, wearing metallic armor, or entangled by a kaion’s sclerites. Any creature affected is pulled up to 10 feet toward the kaion, plus an additional 10 feet for every 5 by which its CMD is exceeded, stopping in the nearest adjacent square. This movement doesn’t provoke attacks of opportunity. If a creature is affected only because of an object it holds, it can drop the object to cease being pulled; this does not require an action.

Unsecured metallic objects in the area are automatically pulled 30 feet toward the kaion, stopping in the nearest adjacent square.

Sclerites (Ex)

As a standard action, a kaion can fire a sharpened piece of its metallic exoskeleton as a ranged attack at a target within 120 feet. The sclerite lodges in or sticks to the target on a hit, causing the target to become entangled as long as the sclerite remains. An entangled creature can remove a sclerite as a move action by succeeding at a DC 13 Reflex save or Escape Artist check. This DC is Constitution-based.

Void Adaptation (Ex)

A kaion has immunity to cosmic rays and the environmental effects of vacuum, as well as the no breath universal monster ability. (A kaion doesn’t breathe, and it is immune to effects that require breathing, such as inhaled poison.

This does not give it immunity to cloud or gas attacks that don’t require breathing.)

ECOLOGY

Environment mountains, urban, or vacuum
Organization solitary, pair, or pod (3–12)
Treasure none

Kaions are nautilus-like creatures usually found in asteroid belts or in orbit around planets with rings or multiple moons. They feed on minerals, especially ones high in certain metals. These metals accumulate in the kaions’ exoskeleton, giving the creatures a metallic sheen.

Kaions navigate by following electromagnetic signals, and can also produce pulses of this energy for locomotion and defense. Much to the consternation of starship captains, they are attracted to the electromagnetic signals produced by starships, latching onto them.

Given enough time, a hungry kaion can eat through a starship hull, but the bigger threat is often that they hitch a ride from one star system to another—becoming an invasive species that interferes with moon bases, mining equipment, and local species.

Most kaions are only 3 feet long, but a the much rarer giant kaion species can grow to 10 times that length. A single giant kaion can do significant damage to a starship on its own. They have the ability to travel vast distances and have even been known to attack space stations and colony ships in deep space.
